news.summary: Recent Commonwealth Fund reports outline the nation's grievances with rising healthcare costs and the greater role states could take in protecting those most at risk.

news.title: Kaiser Permanente notches 4.6% Q2 operating margin, $5.3B net income

news.title: Epic faces Federal Trade Commission antitrust investigation, Reuters reports

news.title: Universal Health Services closes $835M Talkspace acquisition
news.summary: Talkspace will retain its brand, structure and broader strategic direction while operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of the brick-and-mortar acute and behavioral care provider. Executives said they expect both businesses to benefit from bidirectional patient referrals.

news.title: Abridge expands AI decision support to more clinicians in bid to become healthcare's copilot
news.summary: Since April, more than 300 enterprise health systems have adopted Abridge's artificial intelligence-based decision support solution, and the company is now making the tool available to every clinician at its partner health systems.

news.title: Study examines how ICHRA adoption could help stabilize ACA risk pools
news.summary: With the instability in the Affordable Care Act's marketplaces, proponents of ICHRA have suggested that these models could help support the risk pools.

news.title: Industry Voices—AI should help cancer patients survive the healthcare system
news.summary: Cancer care navigators are an invaluable resource, but there are nowhere near enough navigators to meet the scale of the need. This is where AI can make a meaningful difference, write the Digital Medicine Society's Jennifer Goldsack and former CMS Chief Medical Officer Lee Fleisher, M.D.

news.title: Regeneron ends eye disease trial for anti-CD3 antibody following safety review
news.summary: Regeneron has hit the brakes on the phase 1/2a trial for an experimental eye inflammation treatment, following an adverse event that tilted the drug’s risk/benefit profile in the wrong direction.

news.title: Merck KGaA lays off 20 staffers in latest blow to US research team
news.summary: The Massachusetts research site for Merck KGaA’s North American division, EMD Serono, has decided to hand pink slips to 20 staffers, Fierce has learned.

news.title: Slate uses Fulcrum to vault onto Nasdaq with $245M financing for migraine trials
news.summary: Slate Medicines is hurtling toward a Nasdaq listing, securing a reverse merger with Fulcrum Therapeutics six months after exiting stealth and ahead of the publication of clinical data on its lead candidate.

news.title: Evaxion scraps solid tumor vaccine to focus on Duke-partnered brain cancer candidate
news.summary: Evaxion has scrapped a next-gen solid tumor vaccine in order to channel resources to a candidate specifically targeting brain cancer.

news.title: Baylor Genetics hit by cybersecurity attack targeting patient, staff information
news.summary: Diagnostic genomics company Baylor Genetics has become the latest victim of a life sciences cybersecurity breach, with both patients and employees affected.

news.title: Building Resilience for the Future of Biopharma Innovation

news.title: FDA clears Lantheus’ Alzheimer’s PET imaging agent Tauklarify
news.summary: Lantheus, which recently agreed to an $8 billion takeover by fellow radiopharma Curium, garnered FDA clearance for its Alzheimer’s PET imaging agent Tauklarify.

news.title: Lilly pens $370M deal with OmniAb for ion channel collab, but details remain vague
news.summary: Antibody platform business OmniAb continues to rack up Big Pharma partnerships, with Eli Lilly signing off on up to $370 million biobucks tied to an ion channel program.

news.title: After 2 undisclosed gene therapy deaths, can China’s alternative regulatory path still be trusted?
news.summary: Two recent patient deaths—both involving severe immune reactions to high-dose, viral vector-delivered gene therapies and a lack of disclosure—have drawn international scrutiny to what appear to be systemic gaps in oversight and transparency within China’s IIT framework.

news.title: AstraZeneca ends phase 3 lung cancer trial after bispecific falls short versus Keytruda
news.summary: AstraZeneca has stopped a phase 3 trial of volrustomig in lung cancer based on interim efficacy data, narrowing the opportunity for a bispecific designed to replace current immune checkpoint inhibitors.

news.title: Skye and Redx form new entity with $125M to advance fibrosis assets
news.summary: Skye Bioscience has entered into an agreement to combine with privately held fibrotic disease biotech Redx Pharma in a deal that will net $125 million in financing for the new public company, called Fibrx Therapeutics.

news.title: Capricor soars on plan to amend DMD filing after adcomm setback
news.summary: Capricor Therapeutics has bounced back from a bruising FDA advisory committee meeting by securing a green light to file an amendment to its approval application, raising hopes that the biotech can rescue its Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy. The biotech’s stock soared following the news.

papers.title: RibAssist 3D: Biplanar Rib-Fracture Detection, Addressing, and Selective 3D Localization from CT-Derived Projections
papers.summary: Rib fractures are common and time-consuming to localize on computed tomography (CT). papers.title: PixSDS: Why Latent SDS Makes Noisy Pixels
papers.summary: Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) enables text-to-3D generation by optimizing rendered images with a pretrained diffusion prior, but latent SDS often produces structured color artifacts and high-frequency texture noise. We identify a failure mode of latent SDS caused by VAE-induced pixel drift: the optimized image can move along pixel-space directions that are weakly constrained by the VAE encoder, so its latent representation remains clean and semantically meaningful while the image itself accumulates visible artifacts. papers.title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning
papers.summary: Large language models generate computationally expensive yet semantically void reasoning on beyond-capability tasks, creating risks where plausible-sounding but incorrect derivations mislead users. We characterize this futile reasoning phenomenon through systematic analysis, revealing universal capability overreach and systematic miscalibration between capability and behavior. The dominant failure mode is specious reasoning, which outputs look superficially valid but contain subtle errors, escalating with task difficulty.
